The blocking item is the join key: package-level consts join on their Go identifier, but an in-body literal has none. The 11 raw: rows have a sibling name: field; the other 20 are bare elements of a []string. The durable home for this limit is the fixture header, which a person editing the file will read. A tracker row nobody is going to action is a worse home for it.
